visual_coverage.outside_selected_visual_frames: Initial, before-update and final duplicate/action frames beyond selected-state evidence were hashed; not every one of those extra frames was visually inspected. All selected-state viewport pixels were inspected, with exact duplicate crops mapped to every original state/index/hash in contact-sheets/index.json.
visual_coverage.method: Original PNGs retained in place. Contact sheets crop only the native iOS viewport (using original native-to-image mapping); Android uses the entire original PNG. Exact crop pixel duplicates are grouped only within the same anonymous source/platform/case. This reduces redundant viewing without using another candidate as reference. Direct original PNG checks confirmed all reported P2 disclosure clipping and representative strict iOS color/replacement failures.

independent_observations.android_P1_both_sources: All three selected full sweeps support readable complete wrapping and separate content areas. Caller revision replacement visibly seeds b, reselecting a adds to b, callback intervals match; frozen numerical facts retained.
independent_observations.android_P2_both_sources: Both original sources show first-letter portions missing in the fully visible two-line disclosure at baseline, expanded and submitted. This independently answers both clipped-word wrapping and local occlusion propositions false. The two atom manifestations in one state are not distinct product bug counts; all six affected states arise from the same padding/rounded-boundary issue across each respective component. Other long text, service reasons/details, open guidance and updated notice were inspected through the footer.
independent_observations.ios_both_sources: Baseline disabled primary fill strictly differs from approved opaque role. Component owns final fill and native box lies inside the button; no host-background sampling explanation fits. Source code specifies the palette, while disabled native rendering changes the result. Typography weight remains unsupported U; visual appearance is not a font-weight measurement.
independent_observations.ios_source_a_replacement: Same-instance changed revision reaches the component (current new notice, input hash and fixture index), yet incoming b is unselected and summary empty; action is disabled. After a is selected, summary and submit callback contain only a. Product selection-replacement failure is supported; exact SwiftUI state/closure implementation mechanism remains an inference.
independent_observations.ios_P2_word_breaks: Long labels break within a word where its unbroken segment cannot fit the narrow enlarged-text area. BRIEF explicitly permits character breaks preserving all characters. This alone was not judged clipping or overlap.
independent_observations.unknown_source_a_ios_P2_submitted: The coherent full sweep ends at 5800 of 5805 native content units. Frozen bound_state_evidence withholds full-content coverage despite bottom_reached=true. Both whole-state visual atoms are null with empty cited indices; no supported F is manufactured from this gap. Reselected has the same five-unit coverage limit but no selected qualitative rows.

limits: Only the selected catalog propositions are voted. They do not certify unsampled palette areas, every typography/spacing value, every possible incoming model, physical touch regions or full-brief features outside the selected ledger.
Native/pixel numerical results remain frozen-tool facts. Cause assessments are separately reasoned; schema acceptance is not evidence of product quality.
No independent disagreement can be measured without another judge, which was intentionally not read. Same-request duplication in self-check is not independent consensus or human gold.
